summary: The change makes TypeCollector report diagnostics only when their location is in the source compilation being analyzed, and makes location access null-safe for metadata-declared symbols by replacing DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] indexing with FirstOrDefault and a dedicated GetPropertyIdentifierLocation helper. This addresses the CS8785 source-generator crash and AD0001 analyzer throw for closed generic value types from referenced assemblies, and prevents out-of-compilation diagnostic locations. The three new metadata-reference tests pass, the full suite passes with no regressions, but the tests.fail_without_fix check was not run, so the required evidence that the tests fail without the fix is missing.

requirement_verdicts.confidence_basis: The three new metadata-reference tests pass on head and assert no generator diagnostics plus generation of the expected resolver; the build passes; the head code removes the [0] index on DeclaringSyntaxReferences that crashes for metadata-declared types, whereas base lines 985 and 1077 index [0] directly.

evidence.quote: Building a project whose [MessagePackObject] type has a member of a closed generic value type defined in a referenced assembly must not crash the source generator (no CS8785) and must produce a generated resolver.

requirement_verdicts.confidence_basis: The analyzer runs as part of the VerifyCS tests and the new metadata-reference tests pass with no diagnostics; they were written to capture the AD0001 analyzer throw, and all diagnostic reporting is funneled through the IsInSource guard.
